test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. When the convicts were led out to work, the convoy soldier noticed that one of the prisoners emptied some earth out of his boots.

B. They all denied the knowledge of it.

C. The prison was searched and a tunnel was found.

D. The Governor came and questioned all the prisoners to find out who had dug the tunnel.
solution:
The correct answer is 'ACDB.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 
 
• The first statement in the sequence should be A&
